name: secure-display-workspace
description: Experimental DRM media protection libraries; applications live only in examples/

scripts.build: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/elements/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && vite build examples/diagnostics && vite build examples/web-components && vite build examples/fairplay-capture
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/elements/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/diagnostics/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/web-components/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/elements/tsconfig.json && node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs packages/elements/test/*.test.mjs && node --test tools/test/fps-sdk-local.test.mjs
scripts.dev: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && vite examples/diagnostics --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.example:diagnostics: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && vite examples/diagnostics --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.example:elements: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/elements/tsconfig.json && vite examples/web-components --host 127.0.0.1
